issue.title: fix radar chart negative value rendering bug if startAtZeroEnabled is false for issue #166

repository.name: Charts
repository.description: Beautiful charts for iOS/tvOS/OSX! The Apple side of the crossplatform MPAndroidChart.

issue.body:
For issue #166 
we have to check if Double(yMin) / interval will be  -1<x<0, if this is the case, ceil(x) would be 0. but I think we need it to be -1.

In order to render the negative values correctly, 

``` swift
 _yAxis.axisMinimum = _yAxis.entries[0];
```

is the key. 

I have been thinking about different ways to fix. But I was suddenly realized the whole reason is the axisMinimum is not changed while the entries have been modified. Add this line solved my problem, and other radar charts remain good on my side. So I think this should be the correct way to fix it.

@danielgindi you must double check here, because I am not sure if you missed to set it, or you intend not to set _yAxis.axisMinimum.

body: Well this is not very clear to me. Can you show a visual example of how negative values should behave in a Radar chart vs. how it is now?

![radarafterfix](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/4375169/8297351/1a7cd54a-198f-11e5-9f02-231439bb7cd8.png)

After I apply the code change, it renders like above, which I think is correct. the center will be -100K, and the interval between each inner web is equal. You could compare it to the previous screenshot.

As I mentioned in the pull request, the magic is `_yAxis.axisMinimum = _yAxis.entries[0]` I am not sure why it is absent currently, only `_yAxis.axisMaximum = _yAxis.entries[entryCount - 1]` is there.

issue.body:
For issue #166
we have to check if Double(yMin) / interval will be -1<x<0, if this is the case, ceil(x) would be 0. but I think we need it to be -1.

negative values using ceil is not correct, I think. This will lead the minimum value is larger than the data values, like if I have -0.5 , 1 , it calculate as [0,1], not [-1,1]. (ceil(-0.5) = 0)

In order to render the negative values correctly,

 _yAxis.axisMinimum = _yAxis.entries[0];

is the key.

I have been thinking about different ways to fix. But I was suddenly realized the whole reason is the axisMinimum is not changed while the entries have been modified. Add this line solved my problem, and other radar charts remain good on my side. So I think this should be the correct way to fix it.

@danielgindi you must double check here, because I am not sure if you missed to set it, or you intend not to set _yAxis.axisMinimum.
